announcements.headline: EQS-News: Q3 2026: ElringKlinger improves key financial metrics and makes further progress in its transformation
announcements.insight: ElringKlinger reports improved Q3 financial metrics and transformation progress. This follows its Q2 momentum and recent technology showcases at IAA and the Hydrogen Expo.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Hydrogen Technology World Expo 2026: EKPO applies fuel cell technology to energy-intensive special-purpose vehicles
announcements.insight: ElringKlinger follows its August NM20 stack testing milestone by applying fuel cell technology to special-purpose vehicles at the Hydrogen Technology World Expo 2026.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: A new milestone for heavy-duty transportation: EKPO unveils its next-generation NM20 stack at IAA Transportation 2026
announcements.insight: ElringKlinger unveils its next-generation NM20 stack at IAA Transportation 2026, following on-road testing launched in August. This demonstrates continued progress in heavy-duty transportation technologies.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: IAA Transportation 2026: ElringKlinger presents next-generation technologies for the transportation and logistics sector
announcements.insight: ElringKlinger showcases technologies at IAA Transportation 2026. This follows earlier announcements regarding aftermarket solutions and fuel cell stack testing.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: EKPO and Akkodis launch on-road testing of NM20 fuel cell stack
announcements.insight: ElringKlinger confirms EKPO stacks power zepp.solutions’ new generation of stationary energy systems. This follows Q2 momentum and extends the aftermarket portfolio to commercial vehicles.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Q2 2026: ElringKlinger maintains strong momentum in profitable growth and E-Mobility ramp-ups
announcements.insight: ElringKlinger reports Q2 2026 momentum in profitable growth and E-Mobility ramp-ups. This follows CFO Isabelle Damen's departure announcement for year-end 2026.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: CFO Isabelle Damen to leave ElringKlinger at year-end 2026
announcements.insight: CFO Isabelle Damen will leave at year-end 2026. This board change follows recent portfolio and product announcements.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: EKPO stacks power zepp.solutions’ new generation of stationary energy systems
announcements.insight: Elringklinger AG stacks power zepp.solutions’ new generation of stationary energy systems. This follows its June extension of the Aftermarket portfolio to include solutions for commercial vehicle.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Elring extends Aftermarket portfolio to include solutions for commercial vehicles from Asian OEMs
announcements.insight: Elringklinger AG expands its Aftermarket portfolio to include solutions for commercial vehicles from Asian OEMs. This broadens its product range without disclosed financial terms.
